name: Azure Standard_D2s_v3
description: General purpose VM - Microsoft-hosted Azure DevOps pipeline agent (Windows 2022 / Ubuntu 22.04)

specifications.notes: TDP: 135W host × (2/64 vCPUs share) × Teads factor ≈ 68W allocated. Agents are ephemeral — spun up per pipeline run and deallocated on completion.

cpu.source: Boavizta API - Intel Xeon E5-2673 v4, scaled to 2/64 vCPU share
cpu.notes: Half of D4s_v3 allocation (2 vs 4 vCPUs)

storage.source: Premium SSD ephemeral disk embodied emissions, proportional share

motherboard_chipset.source: CCF baseline server board, proportional 2/4 vCPU share
